title: Microsoft Edge: upgraded Copilot new tab page, off by default
summary: The briefing passes: the controls, defaults, rollout dates and feature descriptions are supported, including the updated configuration page. All five Learn pages flagged by the pre-check opened successfully. The licensing paragraph should also mention Microsoft's separate statement that Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7, rather than only as an add-on.
